info.name: NEC RBAC Complete API Collection - With Responses
info.description:
NEC Middleware REST API aligned with Spring controllers.

**Endpoints follow REST conventions:** POST to create, PUT /{id} to update.

**Sample values** match V000 seed data (gender/department/region/district/city id=1). Run **Create Role** before **Create User**, then **Login**, then **Get User Context**.

`accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `userId` are auto-captured from Login / Create User / Get User Context responses. `{{userContext}}` holds the full user-context JSON.
